entry_points.text: Boot sets shmem and tmpfs huge prefs, ignoring bad text; init registers tmpfs and mounts shmem, fatal on failure.
Boot flag toggles usercopy validation with warning on bad input; abort logs direction, object, offset and length then dies.
Fill core sanitizes span, resolves mapping, offloads huge, walks unit by unit with rescheduling and byte reporting.
Protect walks registered areas with clamping under guards; release sweeps own areas, wakes waiters, signals hangup and frees.

exports.text: Shmem offers file setup from mount, zero file install, unmapped forwarding, and folio/page read with poison as I/O error.
Truncate exports full truncate, full invalidation, and error removal checking mapping and regular-file type first.
Usercopy check treats zero length valid; fill checks require span inside registered mapping with anon prep, else not-found or no-memory.
Wrappers select copy, zero, continue or poison for shared fill; helper changes write protection over clamped range with batched invalidations.
Move lookup reuses dest area when source inside after anon prep, needing locked address space; unpopulated-WP follows context flags.

hazards.text: Failed tmpfs or shmem mount aborts boot; full truncate must unmap twice or copied pages survive.
Dropping locks for copy needs snapshot and revalidation, retrying on mapping or table divergence.
Mixed locking risks deadlock without probe and retry; large or shared folios fail busy, late huge retries.

invariants.text: THP store rejects inherit under force unless PMD, restarts daemon on change; boot string sets one bitmap per order, ignoring bad input.
Reduced build leaves swap release and file lock as successful no-ops with empty mapping unlock.
Quota has no on-disk file; info-read builds empty tree with maxima and week graces, free erases all entries.
Size sets inode first; full truncate unmaps tail twice for COW races, ranged once inward; growth zeroes exposed tail in cached folio.
Usercopy rejects overflow and null, forbids image overlap, bounds heap by kind, judges stack by disjointness, overlap, arch and depth.
Anon allows faults except minor mode, allocates movable charged folios, uses anon ops while others use file ops.
Table needs present non-leaf, huge is busy; file bound is size pages; install allows empty or marker; retry tracks ops, file, flags, offset.
Fill selects copy, zero, continue or poison; shared cases allocate, else shared zero on empty; continue uses cached folio; poison needs empty.
Huge fill rejects zero, needs alignment, revalidates after retry, refuses occupied; read-protect checks all areas before changing any under guards.
Move needs writable anon pair matching perms, dest registered, passing screening; huge splits unless aligned full; entry reports bytes or error.
Move needs unchanged tables, empty dest, exclusive folio with try-lock; swap and zero preserve dirty and markers under both locks.
Eligible areas register narrowed bits; register skips covered ranges; clear resolves protections first; init is top feature bit.

locks.text: Final truncate marks exiting to block reclaim, cycles tree lock with interrupts off, then truncates all.
Fill prefers lightweight lookup when anon ready else address-space read; session adds change guard with retry; locked copy suppresses faults.
Move read-locks dest, reuses for contained source, else probes then both under address-space read with retry; fallback holds read throughout.

state_machines.text: Acquire finds or creates seeded entry, marks fake if no limits, then actives; release writes back unless empty then erases; query returns next id.
Lazy mode nests until outermost disable; pause reports inactive and freezes requests until resume restores active.
Atomic fill runs acquire to publish with locked fast and unlocked retry paths, mapping each failure to distinct error.
Present move batches under both locks with stability checks; absent handles migration, faults and swap; entry maps tables, splits folios, unwinds all.
Zero wake broadcasts, else in-range faults wake once and detach; release clears own areas; flag update installs new set and context.

structs.text: Reduced tmpfs delegates to ramfs and allows user mounts; shmem VM ops alias generic file ops, file ops alias ramfs.
Quota id stores limits in tree; format and ops bind handlers with dirty no-op; both grace maxima are one week.
Lazy-MMU suite holds one nesting and pause case plus terminator, asserting active states.
Fill cursor bundles context, ranges, mapping, cursors and cached entry; retry snapshot holds ops, file, flags and offset.
Fork, unmap and wait track contexts and woken state; cache is read-only after init; unprivileged tunable ranges zero to one.
